title: Hamas says a son of its chief negotiator was killed in an Israeli strike on Gaza
summary: Associated Press reported Hamas said Azzam al-Hayya, son of chief negotiator Khalil al-Hayya, was killed in an Israeli strike on Gaza.

title: Gazans confined to less than half of strip: UN
summary: Xinhua reported UN humanitarians said 2.1 million people in Gaza remained confined to less than half of the strip and cited OCHA on access constraints.
